data.content_ref: inline:SRC_003 asserts rapid synchronized patching as a centralized advantage, but the problem asks for evidence to distinguish truly independent failure modes from failures that merely appear uncorrelated until a shared cause is found. SRC_003 never supplies such evidence; instead its own countercondition concedes internal redundancy implemented as exact replicas is susceptible to identical-input crashes, a paradigmatic hidden shared cause that makes failures appear independent until the same input or bug triggers them together. The central monitoring it invokes cannot detect this until the correlated trigger hits, so it cannot meet the distinguishing-evidence requirement.
